agent-exchange-feed-screen.toSkillOff: The «to skill» button is switched off in the feed settings.
agent-exchange-feed-screen.noOutcome: No outcome yet — the room has to be finalized before it can become a skill.
agent-exchange-feed-screen.title: Agent exchanges
agent-exchange-feed-screen.description: What the agents discussed outside the task threads: every room with its outcome, what it cost and the link to the task. A useful outcome becomes a skill candidate with one button — the candidate waits for an approval before it reaches anyone.
agent-exchange-feed-screen.empty: No discussion rooms yet. A room is opened on a task card; its outcome shows up here with what it cost.
agent-exchange-feed-screen.totals: {{rooms}} rooms · {{summarized}} with an outcome · {{candidates}} candidates · {{tokens}} tokens · ${{cost}}
agent-exchange-feed-screen.registered: Registered «{{name}}» as a skill candidate. It waits for an approval on the skill lifecycle screen.
agent-exchange-feed-screen.alreadyCandidate: «{{name}}» is already a skill candidate — nothing was created twice.
agent-exchange-feed-screen.loadError: Could not load the agent exchanges.
agent-exchange-feed-screen.registerError: Could not register the skill candidate.

agent-exchange-feed-settings-panel.title: Agent exchange feed
agent-exchange-feed-settings-panel.description: The screen that shows the owner what the agents discussed: every room with its outcome, what it cost and the link to the task. From there one button turns an outcome into a skill candidate, which waits for an approval before it is delivered to anyone. Saving takes effect at the next read of the feed — no server restart.
agent-exchange-feed-settings-panel.limitHint: {{min}}–{{max}} rooms, newest first. The screen says when a company has more. Source: {{source}}
agent-exchange-feed-settings-panel.toSkillHint: Registers the outcome of a room as a skill candidate that waits for an approval. Source: {{source}}
agent-exchange-feed-settings-panel.loadError: Could not load the feed settings.
agent-exchange-feed-settings-panel.saveError: Could not save the feed settings.

agent-exchange-settings-panel.title: Discussion rooms (agent exchange)
agent-exchange-settings-panel.description: A room on an issue card: 2–4 agents on different models answer independently, a finisher writes the summary as an issue document with the cost, and the owner can stop the room at any point. Saving takes effect at the next room open — no server restart.
agent-exchange-settings-panel.maxRoundsHint: Rounds after the independent first answers. Source: {{source}}
agent-exchange-settings-panel.tokenBudgetHint: The room stops when the budget is spent. Source: {{source}}
agent-exchange-settings-panel.responseTimeoutHint: A participant that misses the timeout is marked as an error and the room goes on. Source: {{source}}
agent-exchange-settings-panel.loadError: Failed to load the room rules.

browser-screen-panel.autoClose: Auto-close in {{time}} (idle or at the hard limit).
browser-screen-panel.closingSoon: The screen closes soon. Press Done when you are finished.
browser-screen-panel.tokenValid: Token valid for {{time}} (the open picture keeps streaming).
browser-screen-panel.unreachable: The screen console could not be reached. Fix the settings, then reconnect.

browsers-settings-page.signingOn: Signing is on. The bridge signs documents under the policy of the connector panel.
browsers-settings-page.signingOff: Signing is off after an emergency stop: every sign action is refused until it is turned back on here.
browsers-settings-page.reenableQuestion: Turn signing back on with the stored policy?
browsers-settings-page.noBrowsers: No browsers are configured on this instance.
browsers-settings-page.title: Browsers
browsers-settings-page.description: Live browser screens for sign-ins. While a screen is open, bots do not drive the browser; sessions close on their own after idle or at the hard limit.

channel-settings-panel.errNonNegative: Enter a whole number of 0 or more
channel-settings-panel.errReconcile: Enter a whole number above 0, or leave it empty
channel-settings-panel.hintDmConversations: Comma-separated Telegram endpoint ids, or * for all: the bot's DM becomes one permanent conversation (bridge). Empty — the vendor path.
channel-settings-panel.hintDmStatus: For a bridged DM: one editable status message instead of milestone silence.
channel-settings-panel.hintSplitParts: How many parts a long structured answer may split into inline. 0 — the vendor's single attachment.
channel-settings-panel.hintTelegramFile: Ceiling on one downloaded Telegram file, bytes. The effective limit is the lesser of this and the board attachment ceiling.
channel-settings-panel.hintBoardAttachment: Overall board attachment size limit, bytes.
channel-settings-panel.hintCrossMessages: Newest messages of the same person's adjacent conversation (web ↔ Telegram) quoted into the turn prompt. 0 — the digest is off.
channel-settings-panel.hintCrossMessageChars: Truncation of one quoted message, characters.
channel-settings-panel.hintCrossTotalChars: Total character limit on the quote block.
channel-settings-panel.hintCrossLookback: How old adjacent-conversation messages are still quoted.
channel-settings-panel.hintReconcile: Minimum interval between run-milestone sweep passes, ms. Empty — the standard pace.
channel-settings-panel.title: Channels (Telegram & chat bridges)
channel-settings-panel.description: The Telegram bridge switches, the attachment ceilings and the cross-channel numbers. Every value applies without a restart — the consumers re-read these settings on use. Environment variables stay forced overrides above the saved value; a pinned key is read-only and shows its variable name.

clouds-settings-page.accountsHint: The connector keeps the cloud token; no bot ever sees it. One account per provider.
clouds-settings-page.accessHint: Each row hands one folder to an agent, a caste or everyone. A folder shared with us can only be read.
clouds-settings-page.noGrants: No folder is shared with anyone yet.
clouds-settings-page.title: Clouds
clouds-settings-page.description: Connect a cloud once and hand folders to agents. Tokens stay in the connector; agents only reach what is granted to them, and every operation lands in the journal.
clouds-settings-page.foldersHint: A folder is either a path inside the connected account or a folder somebody shared with it (read only).
clouds-settings-page.finishSignIn: Finish the sign-in for {{provider}} in the new tab.

connector-panel.dailyLimitError: Enter a whole number greater than zero, or leave it empty
connector-panel.loadError: Failed to load the connector panel.

owner-delivery-screen.title: Owner Telegram delivery
owner-delivery-screen.description: Which cards a task owner receives in their Telegram direct messages. Saving applies to the whole instance at once.
owner-delivery-screen.modeViaBotDescription: No cards with buttons. The agent that raised the question writes the owner a plain message that explains what to decide and why; the owner answers in the chat and the agent records the decision. The default.
owner-delivery-screen.modeOwnerOnlyDescription: Only cards that wait for the owner — a question or an approval an agent raised to unblock its task.
owner-delivery-screen.modeAllDescription: Every card an agent raises for the owner, including notes and reports that need no answer.
